Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 24
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator produced the final answer “Bananas, Lemons, Watermelon” by misidentifying the painting’s fruits (even citing “cabbage” among fruits) and incorrectly substituting categories (treating lemons as generic citrus and watermelon as a stand-in for “melon”) instead of matching exact items from the October 1949 SS Île de France breakfast menu. This ignored the actual overlap (pears and bananas) and the required verification/order from the painting, directly leading to the wrong solution.
